# PAPER identity baseline

`s1-book.json` is the complete `paper_book` row captured before TASK-015 at
commit `751f10e0f18aada7b3477c63de93708bd0a14954`. Both default `PaperSettings`
and `config/paper.yaml` produced this row on the synthetic bars from 2023-10-02
through 2023-10-30, with only the start date moved into the fixture period.
No market data or credentials are included.
